name: Iverron's Antidote
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron waits for medicine before its strength fades. Poisoned by Webwood spiders, the night elf scout depends on Dirania Silvershine's brew, which must reach him within five minutes.

sections.title: A Race Against the Clock
sections.body: Dirania Silvershine brews the cure from fresh venom sacs, lily roots, and hyacinth fungi. The unstable mixture keeps its strength for only five minutes after it is distilled. Whoever carries the vial must sprint straight from the glade toward the northern heights without hesitation.

sections.title: A Habit of Trouble
sections.body: Webwood spiders around Shadowglen's barrows and caves have poisoned Iverron. He admits he has a habit of stumbling into danger and often depends on Dirania's herbal skill to save him. Even after drinking the antidote, his recovery is fragile. The hostile spiders still guard his way home, and he remains wary of them.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on delivering the antidote?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine's antidote loses its healing strength quickly because it is made from fresh natural ingredients and venom. It is useless if Iverron does not drink it within five minutes of leaving her care.
Iverron waits against the rocks outside the northern cave in Shadowglen, north of the grove's main path.
Webwood spiders poisoned Iverron. They live on Shadowglen's northern outskirts, where they have multiplied around Teldrassil's roots and caves.

faq.q: What happens after Iverron drinks the antidote?
faq.answer: The antidote neutralizes the poison, but Iverron remains too weak and shaken to travel safely alone. He asks for help clearing the nearby Webwood spiders that block his way back to safety.

faq.q: What relationship do Dirania and Iverron have?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is an herbalist and healer in Shadowglen who often rescues Iverron from trouble. He admits that he keeps getting into danger and that Dirania is always helping him out.

faq.q: What happens if the antidote expires before reaching him?
faq.answer: If the brew spoils before it reaches Iverron, you need a fresh dose from Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen and must make the run again.

angles.text: As a young night elf training in Shadowglen, you see Iverron's rescue as a sobering reminder of the corruption and aggression stirring among Teldrassil's native wildlife.
As an herbalist, you know raw woodland plants can be difficult to work with. Their concoctions lose vital properties almost at once without proper preservation.
